title: Dirichlet energy bound on interior balls from the duality bound
statement:
Let n ∈ ℕ and R, E, r ∈ ℝ with 0 < r < R and 0 ≤ E. Let B := B̆_R(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1, D = fderiv ℝ, and let h : ℝⁿ → ℝ be of class C² on B. Assume the duality bound: for every Φ = (Φ_0, …, Φ_{n−1}) with each Φ_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ C¹, compactly supported and tsupport Φ_i ⊆ B,
∫_B Σ_i Dh(x)(e_i)·Φ_i(x) dx ≤ √E·√(∫_B Σ_i Φ_i(x)² dx).
Then ∫_{B̆_r(0)} ‖Dh(x)‖² dx ≤ E.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R E r : ℝ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < r → r < R → 0 ≤ E → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → (∀ Φ : Fin n → Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ i)) → (∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Φ i)) → (∀ i, tsupport (Φ i) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ h x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * Φ i x ≤ Real.sqrt E * Real.sqrt (∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, Φ i x ^ 2)) → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) r, ‖fderiv ℝ h x‖ ^ 2 ≤ E
